verses.en: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.sm: Iuta; ua silisili lona suafa i Isaraelu.

verses.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.sm: Ua i Salema foi lona fale apitaga ; ua i Siona foi lona afioaga.

verses.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.sm: Na ia gauia i lea mea o u fanafana mu, o le talita, le pelu, ma le taua. Sela. E pupula mai oe, e silisili,

verses.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.sm: e sili i mauga o i ai mea E saeia. O e loto tetele ua vetea a latou mea;

verses.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.sm: ua latou momoe i o latou moe; e leai foi so latou o e malolosi ua maua o latou lima.

verses.en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.sm: Le A:ua o Iakopo e, o le aoaiga mai ia te oe ua moe gagase ai le kariota atoa ma le solofanua.

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.sm: O oe e matautia lava oe; o ai foi se tu atu i ou luma i ona po e te toasa mai ai? Ua lagona atu mai ia te oe mai le lagi le faamasinoga;

verses.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.sm: ua matatau ai le lalolagi ma fifilemu, ina va tulai le Atua e faamasino ai,

verses.en: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.sm: e faaola ai i e puapuagatia uma lava o i le lalolagi. Sela.

verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.sm: A4a o le ita tele o tagata e yna ai oe; e re taofia foi le toe ita. la outou tauto atu i le AL11 lo outou Atua,

verses.en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.sm: ma ia avatua ana mea; o i latou uma o e vagavagai ia te ia, ia latou avatu mea alofa i le ua matautia.

verses.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.sm: E faamaulaloina e ia o loto o alii; e matautia o ja e tupu o le lalolagi. II 12 13 14 15
